title: Salesfinity Pricing in 2026: Gold, Enterprise and Alternatives
summary: Salesfinity Gold is $249 a license a month billed annually or $299 month to month; Enterprise is $299 on a 12-month plan. See add-ons and priced alternatives.
body_markdown:
Salesfinity publishes its prices. Gold, the calling license, is $249 a license a month billed annually, or $299 month to month with 30 days' notice. Enterprise is $299 a license a month on a 12-month plan. One to five licenses can be bought online by card. Six or more get a volume quote. Read on November 11, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Salesfinity detail below comes from Salesfinity's own pricing page and FAQ, opened on November 11, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no paid Salesfinity account was used. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. Salesfinity](https://www.trellus.ai/salesfinity) .


## Salesfinity pricing at a glance


Salesfinity's[pricing page](https://salesfinity.ai/pricing) lists two paid licenses for people who make calls, plus two license types for people who do not dial all day.

The page says every price is public and that there is no setup fee and no platform fee. It does not list a free trial. For teams of 100 or more licenses it mentions a 30-day pilot.


## What changes the real cost of Salesfinity


The list price is clear. The final bill depends on the term, the license mix, a few add-ons and some charges that follow usage.


### Annual or month to month


Gold costs $50 more a license a month without an annual commitment: $299 against $249. Salesfinity says annual Gold locks the price. Leaving a month-to-month Gold plan takes 30 days' notice.


Enterprise has no monthly option. It is a 12-month plan at $299 a license a month. Salesfinity's[FAQ](https://salesfinity.ai/faq) says card checkout covers Gold monthly or annual and Enterprise annual.


As an example, five Gold licenses come to $1,245 a month on annual billing, or $14,940 for the year. The same five licenses month to month come to $1,495 a month. The page's own calculator shows ten Enterprise licenses at $2,990 a month, or $35,880 a year, at list.


### Volume pricing from six licenses


Online purchase stops at five licenses. From six licenses on an annual plan, Salesfinity quotes a volume price after a 30-minute demo. The page says the volume price is below list, so the published prices act as a ceiling.


### Add-ons priced per license


- **AI Sequencer on Gold:** $60 more a license. It is included in Enterprise.
- **International calling:** $50 more a license a month for calls to more than 120 other countries. Dialing the US and Canada is included and described as unlimited within fair use.


### Charges that follow usage


- **Ari, the AI assistant:** priced by use at $0.01 a credit, in packs from $100 that never expire. Each Enterprise license includes $20 of Ari work a month. On Gold, Ari is by use from the first credit. The team sets one monthly budget, and Ari stops at that cap.
- **Mobile numbers:** Enterprise includes 200 a license a month. Extra mobile numbers are $0.30 each.


### Seats that do not dial all day


Admin licenses for managers who watch and coach are free. Light licenses for account managers and customer success staff are listed at $99. Counting these correctly can lower the total for a mixed team. Ask Salesfinity what a light license can and cannot do before you rely on one.


### Switching costs


Salesfinity says it buys out the rest of another vendor's contract for teams that qualify. The check happens on a demo call, so treat it as something to confirm, not a given.


## Who Salesfinity fits and who it does not


Salesfinity fits a team that wants parallel dialing on up to five lines and can pay $249 or more for each caller. The Gold license also lists a virtual salesfloor, call scoring, practice calls, and HubSpot and Salesforce sync.


Enterprise fits a team that would otherwise buy a sequencer, a list-building tool and mobile numbers separately. Those are bundled into the $299 license, and Salesfinity's FAQ adds a named success manager from 10 licenses.


Small teams can start without a sales call. One to five licenses are sold by card, and Salesfinity says a team can start calling the same day.


Salesfinity is a weaker fit for a team that needs a lower seat price for calling alone. It is also not the match for a buyer who wants the Enterprise features without a 12-month term, or who wants a free trial before paying. The pricing page lists neither.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Salesfinity cost per user?


Salesfinity's pricing page lists Gold at $249 a license a month billed annually, or $299 month to month. Enterprise is $299 a license a month on a 12-month plan. Admin licenses are free and light licenses are listed at $99. Teams of six or more on an annual plan get a volume quote.


### Can you pay for Salesfinity month to month?


Yes, on Gold only. Month-to-month Gold is $299 a license with 30 days' notice, which is $50 more than annual Gold at $249. Enterprise has no monthly option. It is sold as a 12-month plan at $299 a license a month, and card checkout covers Enterprise on annual billing.


### Does Salesfinity have a free trial?


Salesfinity's pricing page does not list a free trial. It says one to five licenses can be bought online by card and used the same day, and it mentions a 30-day pilot for teams of 100 or more licenses. Ask Salesfinity directly if a trial matters to your evaluation.


### What is the difference between Salesfinity Gold and Enterprise?


Gold is the calling license: the parallel dialer, virtual salesfloor, call scoring and practice calls. Enterprise adds the AI Sequencer, 200 mobile numbers a license a month, Ari with $20 of work a month, AI list building and Live Assist. On annual billing, Enterprise costs $50 more a license than Gold.


### What costs extra on Salesfinity?


Calling more than 120 countries outside the US and Canada adds $50 a license a month. The AI Sequencer adds $60 a license on Gold. Ari credits are $0.01 each beyond what a license includes, and extra mobile numbers are $0.30 each. Salesfinity lists no setup fee or platform fee.
